mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because it explained how local electrical changes can pass a message along a nerve cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: Developing the two cell types repeated the earlier pattern of pairing a precursor with a named protein. The purposes were clear from the introduction, but the choices were fairly predictable.

surprise.text: I was surprised that no single ion has to travel the whole length of the nerve for a message to travel along it.

arbitrary.text: The protein pairings were given by the story rather than something I could work out independently. I understood that they were developmental messages, but not how the messages caused the cells to change.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because seeing how channels and insulating cells work together made me curious about what happens when the message reaches muscle.
